THE LESSON IS RECORDED IN THE SCOPE REPORT: F-017-02 correctly identified the authoring lane as part of the atomic change, then assumed that updating its instruction would produce compliance; three publishes falsified that. A prose instruction to a language model is advisory, whereas routing the lane through the certified composer makes compliance structural, because the lane can no longer emit a non-conforming envelope when it no longer emits the envelope at all. A PROCESS DEVIATION is recorded rather than hidden: scripts/build-attention-items.mjs was first created by the test-writing agent in breach of its stated boundary, and was subsequently completed and verified under the implement role. The artifact is sound on the recorded evidence; the independence of its RED run is not, because that RED is a RED against code the test author wrote.
